_about: Legend: The Fisherman and his Wife (Grimm KHM 19), lines for H1+E1 (Jonny picked 27 Nov 23:31 Berlin). Our kid wishes himself, one evening on the Baltic shore; the sea's colour is the counter. Speakers: N narrator, G grandmother, K kid, F flounder.

G.style: an old woman in her eighties, warm but stern, low slightly raspy voice, slow and calm

K.style: a twelve-year-old boy from a film, natural child actor, clearly a boy, voice not broken yet, curious and quietly worried, speaks clearly with crisp diction
K._af: ep1 kid brightening chain, applied up front (wolf video: 7 of 28 K takes MUFFLED without it)

F.style: an enchanted prince living as a flat fish, smooth and polite, faintly amused, a little cold underneath, calm

lines: Grandma... why is the sea black?
Because you didn't stop at one.
Six hours earlier, the Baltic was green. And the fish he caught could talk.
Let me go. I'm not a fish. I'm a prince.
Wish once. Then throw it back.
One wish. A real house for Grandma.
The hut became a cottage. And the sea turned grey.
The Brothers Grimm printed this story in 1812. The couple in it lived in a hut the tale calls a pot.
Flounder, flounder, in the sea! I want a castle!
excited, calling out over the water
Dark blue. Thick. And it started to smell.
I've seen the sea this colour once before.
Make me king of the whole coast!
One more, and I can't give it back.
Just one more. Make the sun come up when I say!
The waves stood up like church towers.
Castle. Crown. Cottage. Gone. Just the old hut. And a green sea.
Why didn't you warn me better?
Child... why do you think I live in a pot?
